title: (RHBA-2021:0654) Satellite 6.8.4 Async Bug Fix Update
portal_summary: Updated Satellite 6.8 packages that fix several bugs are now available for Red Hat Satellite.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Satellite|Red Hat Satellite Capsule|6.8|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For detailed instructions how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/documentation/en-us/red_hat_satellite/6.8/html/upgrading_and_updating_red_hat_satellite/updating_satellite_server_capsule_server_and_content_hosts
portal_description:
Red Hat Satellite is a system management solution that allows organizations to configure and maintain their systems without the necessity to provide public Internet access to their servers or other client systems. It performs provisioning and configuration management of predefined standard operating environments.

This update fixes the following bugs:

1919400	Cannot build a RHEL 8.3 system via Satellite Full Host Bootdisk or Discovery kexec
1919405	uncaught exception after a celery worker process abruptly terminates, resulting in a hung task
1919409	Incremental update of the content view takes very long time to complete
1919412	Candlepin stops responding and webgui fails with SSL_connect error
1919413	Satellite upgrade from 6.7 to 6.8 fails
1919414	Wrong deps are added when publishing content view with "solve_dependencies=true"
1919415	Ansible temporary files are not removed from the /tmp directory.
1919417	[candlepin] Manifest delete takes 24 hours or more in large environment (60k consumers in owner)
1919418	[candlepin] Unable to import subscription manifest in large environment (60K+ consumers/hosts)
1919419	Satellite upgrade to 6.7.3 version fails at disabling sync plan stage with error 'Cannot update a cancelled Recurring Logic'
1919420	puppet run fails with error parameter 'port' expects a Stdlib::Port = Integer[0, 65535] value, got String
1919430	"hammer status" returns 500 ISE when a Capsule or Satellite has foreman-proxy "logs" feature disabled
1919431	When in Simple Content Access mode, hypervisors with no subscription attached show as 'unsubscribed hypervisor' in their Subscription sub-status
1919434	foreman-maintain package lock check indicates false failure
1919436	Host errata status not refresh after CV publish/promote
1919442	Hypervisors being reported with number_of_cpus and cores_per_socket == 0

Users of Red Hat Satellite are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which fix these bugs.
